description: Economic inputs for the 19 November 2026 PB allocation review. Every value carries an evidence status. Values marked 'assumption' are scenario parameters, not verified data.

evidence_status_vocabulary.verified_source: Read from a cited external statistic or published dataset and re-checked.
evidence_status_vocabulary.verified_model_output: Read from the project's own model output (SuperPro or MILP); verified as the model value, not as real-world data.
evidence_status_vocabulary.assumption: User or inherited assumption without an external source. Must be reported as a scenario.
evidence_status_vocabulary.illustrative: Teaching or placeholder value with no economic basis. Historical comparison only.

production.product_form: Purified bulk mAb drug substance. Detailed ICR entries include filling labour, cartridges and 20-L bags despite the zero summary line. Retail fill-finish is outside the assessed gate. Reconcile bulk handling and packaging with the partial inventory.

inherited_selling_price.source: User-specified $200/g carried through the 14 November allocation review. No market, contract or literature source is recorded in the project.
inherited_selling_price.interpretation: Assumed ex-works value of bulk drug substance.

superpro_unit_production_cost.source: 01_SuperPro/rawSP_reports/mab_fedbatch_1000_sut_ICR.xls, 'SUMMARY PER COST ITEM (Entire Process)' TOTAL 92,098.02 $/kg MP (2019 prices) = 51,848,755 $/year / 562.97 kg MP/year (SuperPro 'Unit Production Ref. Rate'; 121 x 4.65 = 562.65 kg differs by 0.06% because the batch size is rounded).
superpro_unit_production_cost.interpretation: Full average production cost used as a zero-margin output-value proxy. Facility costs are 53.36% at 121 batches/year. Scaling the unit cost to 861 batches assumes unchanged unit economics. It does not establish a producer price or a price floor.

USD_per_GBP_2019.source: Bank of England XUAAUSS 2019 annual average, recorded in 08_Parameters/MILP_central_params.json currency_and_price_year_conversions.calculation_inputs

UK_GDP_deflator_2019.source: ONS YBGB, Blue Book vintage released 30 October 2026

UK_GDP_deflator_2022.source: ONS YBGB, same vintage as 2019 value

GBP_per_EUR_2022.source: ECB euro reference rate, 2022 annual average (Bundesbank compilation)

currency_conversion.caveat: The GDP deflator is a general UK price index, not a pharmaceutical producer price index. The target unit matches EXIOBASE (million EUR, current 2022 basic prices).

population_weight_GB.source: vendor/pbaesa/pbaesa/allocation.py get_population_weights(), GB share of 2022 world population used inside the Hartmann factors

retired_inherited_network_gva_USD2019_mi.source: 07_PB/review/preconstraint_audit_20261114/allocation_review.json; rounded user inputs, derivation not recorded.
retired_inherited_network_gva_USD2019_mi.why_retired: Only used for the 'network direct GVA / sector direct GVA x total GVA factor' scenario, which is internally inconsistent: EXIOBASE total GVA of the sector equals its gross output, so the matched key is the output share. Kept for traceability only.
